body:
It was a Monday afternoon and I had just got home from work, and my girlfriend was at home here waiting for me.  I  had ordered some Salvia online a week earlier and the box was in my door, so her and I decided to try some out right away, seeing as how this would be both our first times.  It was very sunny and bright outside, but I had the shades drawn so only a band of light shone against the far walls.  After reading up on salvia for about 5 minutes, we decided to give it a shot, using my water pipe.  I put roughly a gram (10x Extract) in it and smoked it all at once, after holding it in for about 20 seconds I sucked the rest out of the pipe through the trigger opening, and then loaded in just a little bit more.  At first it felt like the typical psychadelic, mushrooms came to mind immediately.
I felt myself slumping over to one side and I felt that giggly feeling that first comes on with most psychadelics, but then almost instantly everything changed.  The band of light on the wall appeared to be some kind of fence and then instantly I felt like I was outside in a field.. I didnt see this actually happening but my eyes seemed to change everything around me according to what I was feeling at that moment.  I was outside in a field, with a white fence, and there appeared to be some kind of giant wheel infront of me, lets call it a ferris-wheel, because it slowly turned but stayed in one place.  My girlfriend was sitting next to me the entire time, and I think she was slightly scared by the look on my face through all this.  I tried to talk to her but this was nearly impossible. My words just didnt want to come out, I had to think each and every word through until I had actually spoken it, and even then she said I sounded like I was very drunk. After the room returned to normal and I no longer felt like I was outside, I still felt a strong psychadelic feeling, but no more visuals.
After this she said she wanted to try, and I could see a little bit of fear in her eyes, but I told her I was right here.  She fired up the same amount that I did, sucked through the trigger, then loaded up a small bit more.  She is Diabetic, and I have noticed that marijuana is much stronger on her then some other people, as are the effects of alcohol when she does drink.  She sat there for a moment and then a smile crossed her face and she started to laugh almost uncontrolably for a moment, and then she just gazed into the shaded windows for a minute.. She didnt say a word through the whole thing, she just sat there twitching a bit, and giggling, and then she kinda fell over and her face landed in my lap, and she kept giggling.  Then she sat up straight, with a straight look, and asked me what the hell had just happened. I told her, and she said that she felt like (and seen) a giant umbrella shaped balloon under her, and that it carried her away.. She said that there was also a figure that resembled mary poppins (woman who flies with an umbrella) who told her to give me felatio, which is why she said her face fell into my lap, although nothing did come of that.  She felt the same after effects that I did, and after about 30 minutes I felt completly sober, with no ill effects at all.  It felt like it lasted an eternity but she told me I was only actuially under for 3 - 5 minutes, which I find amazing.  I'd like to try this outside in an actual field sometime.  As far as experiences go, I will not soon forget this one.
